assets.prompt:
Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery, and purposeful spacing. This is ONE independent visual direction named "场景厨房工作台", not a storyboard or a collage.
Target: redesign the real existing Godot nutrition life strategy game 好好吃饭. The attached screenshots are actual current UI and art references, not a layout to clone. Preserve the warm hand-painted everyday Chinese setting, recognizable bowls of rice and soft tofu with green vegetables, and Zhou Huilan's mature 66-year-old identity. Correct the current generic restaurant-card UI and wall-of-text popup by showing a dedicated cooking WORKSPACE.
Current date anchor: 2026-10-14. The game uses a fictional seven-day week; visible phase must be 第1天 · 早餐, with no invented calendar dates.
Target dimensions: 640 x 960 portrait web-game viewport, app content only. No browser chrome, device, OS bar, notch or framing. Natural composition; no stretched screenshots.
Design ONE focused primary screen: preparing 白米饭 + 时蔬炖豆腐 at home. Clear hero use case and a single primary action 开始做饭. One or two support actions only, such as 换菜 and 查看冰箱. The rest of the game's story selection, fridge, weekly diary and saves exist off-screen.
Art direction: tactile illustrated kitchen worktop, warm morning window light, clean pale ivory UI surfaces (#F8F0E2), deep umber text (#40372F), muted sage (#6F7E5F), small terracotta accent (#BE6948). Zhou Huilan appears naturally at the kitchen counter as part of the scene: short silver-streaked dark hair, olive cardigan, mature lively face, no frailty stereotype. She must not be a huge static cutout blocking controls. Make the scene feel like her own kitchen and morning routine, with sheet music set aside. Large inviting food illustration above the actual preparation controls.
Top compact identity and objective: 周阿姨的厨房, 第1天 · 早餐, 汇演准备 0/70. Show 余额 ¥210 as a small resource, not an analytics dashboard. Visible navigation should be minimal.
The core workspace on the lower part of the SAME PAGE is a continuous work surface, not nested cards or a centered modal: selected dishes with thumbnails and a 换菜 link; clear 调味 preset choices 不另加 / 少放一点 / 按原口味, current 少放一点 visibly selected and paired amounts 盐1克 + 酱油5毫升; 当餐1人份; 留存 selection 只做当餐 or 另备1份冷藏, with 只做当餐 selected. Structured controls with touch targets >=44px. Display known teaching fact 追加调味钠约750毫克 and a concise scope note 仅计已记录调味，食材本底未记录. No false daily total, health diagnosis, nutrition score, or zero-unknown claims.
Layout priority: grouping, alignment, typography and whitespace first, thin separators second, subtle tints third, few borders, minimal shadows. No repeated big brown buttons, no endless stock list, no tooltip over the primary action, no horizontal carousel clipped off-screen. Chinese UI type should be readable with 18-20px body text and no more than 2 fonts, normal weights for body and a graceful serif title. Include all important controls without crowding; omit decorative feature lists. The result should look like an implementable high-quality illustrated game interface, not a poster.

Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery, and purposeful spacing. ONE independent visual direction named "生活食谱手账", not a storyboard, not multiple options on one image.
Target: redesign existing Godot game 好好吃饭, a Chinese nutrition education life-strategy game for adults and their younger family members. Actual current UI screenshots are attached as problem/context and art references. Preserve recognizable warm hand-painted food illustrations, Chinese everyday culture and Zhou Huilan age66, but replace generic purchase cards and giant text modals with a dedicated cooking PAGE.
Current date anchor 2026-10-14. Visible game time 第1天 · 早餐, a fictional seven-day scenario. No real calendar dates or invented weekdays.
Target dimensions 640 x 960 portrait web-game app content, no device bezel, OS status bar, browser chrome, shadows outside the app or external presentation frame.
Visual concept: an elegant illustrated personal recipe journal used at the breakfast table. One continuous creamy paper PAGE as the app's base surface, elegant dark ink Chinese serif title + very readable regular sans-serif body, hand-drawn small annotations and restrained sage/coral watercolor accents. Calm, airy, tactile, sophisticated editorial layout, extremely clear hierarchy. Do NOT reproduce the old stack of beige cards and brown buttons; no card-in-card, no whole app contained in a centered card. No giant immersive room photo; ingredient and cooked-food still-life illustrations carry the character of this direction.
Primary screen is a focused breakfast recipe sheet headed 今天的早餐 / 给自己做一顿饭. Compact top identity 周慧兰 · 66岁 and own goal 汇演准备0/70, with a small handwritten choir-sheet bookmark making her own hobby visible. Her mature portrait is modest and integrated beside a short personal note, not floating in front of controls and not youthified.
Hero drawing: complete breakfast setting with one bowl of 白米饭 and one bowl of 时蔬炖豆腐. Show small pencil callouts to their source ingredients 米、豆腐、青菜; no claims about exact ingredient nutrients or invented physical weights. A supporting 换菜 link only.
Below the hero, visually grouped practical recipe controls in the same paper page, separated by thin rules and generous space. In numbered recipe order: 备好食材 (米1份、豆腐1份、青菜1份, explicitly game份数); 调味 (three small segmented presets 不另加 / 少放一点 / 按原口味, selected 少放一点 shows 盐1克 + 酱油5毫升); 人数与留存 (当餐1人份, 只做当餐 selected, 另备1份冷藏 as alternative). Controls must be genuine UI-looking radio/segmented choices, not annotations pretending to be buttons, and actual tap areas >=44px.
Give the correct teaching quantity in a small supporting line: 追加调味钠约750毫克. Scope note: 仅计已记录调味，食材本底未记录. No medical or dietary diagnosis, nutrition score, false total intake, or unknown-as-zero.
ONE unmistakable full-width primary action at bottom: 按这份菜谱做饭. Use deep sage for that action, not many big brown buttons. Minimal navigation back to 今天 or 冰箱, with the rest of the weekly schedule, shared dining, saves and character stories existing off-screen. Avoid feature inventory and dashboard metrics.
Typography 18-20px for readable body in target 640wide screen, title about32-36px, use <=2 fonts. Hierarchy via alignment, spacing and type first, thin separators second, subtle tints third. Minimal rounded borders and no heavy drop shadows. Fit all key controls without clipping or tiny fine print. This should look like a production-ready polished game UI, not a decorative poster.

Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery, and purposeful spacing. ONE independent direction named "清爽生活界面", not a collage or a storyboard and no numbered option badge.
Redesign the existing Chinese Godot life-strategy nutrition game 好好吃饭. The attached actual screenshots are the current implementation whose hierarchy and modal-heavy mechanisms need redesign; use the existing recognizable hand-painted foods and 66-year-old Zhou Huilan as art references, NOT the old card layout. Intended players include age45+ adults and their younger relatives. Practical reading and direct task control are essential.
Current date anchor 2026-10-14. Fictional game time 第1天 · 早餐 only. Avoid calendar dates, invented song names or claiming next week's performance. Her established goal is to perform in her community choir on day7 of this week, preparation progress0/70.
Target dimensions 640 x 960 portrait web-game content only, no device, OS chrome, status bar, home indicator, external frame, wallpaper around an app card, or warped screenshots.
Art direction: a calm, premium modern illustrated game workspace with warm white #FAF7F0, dark readable #31392F text, restrained sage #5D7258, small warm apricot accents. Plain base surface, generous whitespace, fine row separators, at most two typefaces (Chinese sans-serif body and refined serif display). No glossy brown buttons, no stacked beige boxes, no heavy shadow, and no card-in-card. Keep light hand-painted food illustration accents; this is still a welcoming life game, not a hospital or business dashboard.
ONE focused primary screen: 周阿姨 · 做早餐. Header has a small mature silver-streaked portrait and simple back-to-today affordance; she is an independent person with her own choir goal, not a decorative figure covering content. Compact unobtrusive 第1天 · 早餐, 余额¥210, 本周汇演准备0/70. No six health meters, rankings or nutrition scores.
Primary cooking workflow is visible as three steps 选菜 → 调味与份量 → 完成, with 调味与份量 active. Main content starts with a clean selected-food row containing beautiful bowl illustrations of 白米饭 and 时蔬炖豆腐 and a modest 换菜 action. Ingredient relation 米1份、豆腐1份、青菜1份 (游戏份数) is directly below, so users understand what will be consumed.
Then two clearly labeled sections on the same surface:
调味: three equal-size, high-contrast segmented choices 不另加 / 少放一点 / 按原口味. 少放一点 is selected; its readable amount row 盐1克 + 酱油5毫升 appears beneath. Three presets map to salt/soy 0g+0mL, 1g+5mL, 2g+10mL, don't invent independent sliders for incompatible combinations. Show one small information line 追加调味钠约750毫克; scope note 仅计已记录调味，食材本底未记录. No false daily totals or diagnosis.
当餐与留存: clear 当餐1人份 row and an independent segmented choice 只做当餐 / 另备1份冷藏, with first selected. Chilled extra portion means an extra set of ingredients, not extra eating. Expose that relation with a short contextual sentence, without a long policy disclaimer.
Sticky bottom review line 本次：米1份 · 豆腐1份 · 青菜1份 followed by ONE green primary CTA 确认做饭. One support action 查看冰箱 only if space allows. Touch targets at least44px and body type18-20px at640wide, not tiny text. No excess navigation items, controls, decorative metrics or feature inventory. Let saves, social dining and the diary exist on their own pages off-screen.
The result must look immediately implementable, crisp and readable, with natural hierarchy, balanced proportions and a clearly persistent primary action; a complete app screen, not a decorative presentation poster.
